digest.component_or_area: Compaction and event store lifecycle management
propositions: Compaction must work with no CI and no local cron as a fallback to scheduled sweeps, triggered out-of-band after safe lock release on operations like close
Two-arm selection enables both backfill (no SNAPSHOT with foldable events) and recurrence (foldable count over threshold) to prevent one-time-only compaction and growth without bound
Honest counting observes SNAPSHOT artifacts before/after rather than return codes to correctly report which folds produced work, preventing infinite re-selection of no-op folds
Detached worker execution with stamped advisory locks prevents concurrent compactor storms and reuses existing drain lock patterns to avoid pid-recycle and wall-clock issues
Scheduled CI workflow on 6-hourly cadence reuses proven reconcile-bridge recipes (store mount, bot identity, signing key materialization) for disposable runners without long-lived clones

Selection predicate must reuse the fold engine's own is_foldable horizon check to prevent selecting tickets whose excess events are all inside the horizon, which would fold nothing and re-select forever
